test_title: PYST 1: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. **

It is difficult to say / which of the / two girls in that house / is the eldest.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **is the eldest**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Replace the superlative** 'eldest'** with comparative **'elder'** to make the sentence correct.
 
• **Comparative adjectives** are used to **compare two people or things**.
 
 
• **Example -** *My house is **larger **than hers.*
 
 
 
• **Superlative adjectives** are used to **compare more than two people or things**.
 
 
• **Example -** *Elephants are the **largest **land animals alive today.*
 
 
 
• *​*In the given sentence "**which of the two girls**" is mentioned, so we should use a** comparative degree.**

**​**Therefore, **option 3** is the correct answer.

**Corrected sentence:** *It is difficult to say which of the two girls in that house is the **elder**__ one.*

7c
